closure_criteria: No unresolved Driver review, exact-set synthesis, follow-up publication, or parent-closure decision remains for the pinned Perfect HCM0 and N-coupled frontiers.

The mathematical parent objectives are either still open with an explicitly routed successor outside this continuity package, or are separately closed through their own objective authority; this Driver continuity objective never closes them by itself.
The durable Driver handoff points to the final operational publications/reviews and contains no stale owner or superseded research route as the current entrypoint.
research_value: Prevent loss of the exact mathematical frontier during conversation/Driver turnover, especially after the Perfect HCM0 task split into two claimable successors and the N-coupled line reached a coverage/closure classification boundary.
scope: Maintain exact control-plane continuity for the current Perfect Prime HCM0 successor pair and the N-coupled public-effective resource-coverage task. This objective governs Driver review, exact-set reconciliation, follow-up materialization, parent-closure routing, and durable handoff only. It does not prove any mathematical theorem and does not replace the mathematical parent objectives.
success_criteria: Every frozen Result produced by the pinned Perfect HCM0 successor publications or the pinned N-coupled coverage publication receives a source-backed Driver review under the current review/follow-up contracts, or multiple reviews are reconciled through the exact-set authority path before operational follow-up.
Every operational Driver review materializes the required next taskset or a justified parent-objective closure action without duplicating already-published work.
A successor Driver can recover the exact current research publications, immutable handoff sources, review criteria, and next executable control action from source state alone.
title: Driver continuity for Perfect HCM0 and N-coupled coverage frontiers
